'''Suudaa Nem'ro''', often known simply as '''Nem'ro the Hutt''', was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who lived during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was respectfully known as '''Nem'ro the Tenacious''' by other Hutts.

==Biography==
===Life on Nal Hutta===
{{Quote|The upstart Fa'athra lays claim to things that are mine. He moves against my factories, sends his scum to make trouble in Jiguuna.|Nem'ro explains his rivalry with Fa'athra|<ref name="TOR:SA">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Settling Accounts|Hutta}}</ref>}}
[[File:Nemro_throne_room.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Nem'ro in his throne room]]
In the decades leading up to his success, Nem'ro was a cunning leader in the gangs of [[Jiguuna]], an industrial [[City/Legends|town]] on the Hutts' adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]]. He was an ambitious Hutt, using blackmail and savage cunning to systematically muscle his way into complete control over the town. His businesses included [[shvash gas]] mining, dealing [[Spice/Legends|spice]], and trafficking weapons. His path to success earned him enemies along the way including fellow Hutt [[Voontara Fa'athra]], "[[Huttsbane]]," and even [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="HoloNet Bio">{{HolonetOld|biographies|nemro-hutt|Nem'ro the Hutt}}</ref>

Other Hutts in the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] respected Suudaa Nem'ro and designated him as Nem'ro the Tenacious.<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Like most Hutts who reached the peak of their career, Nem'ro eventually left the day-to-day operation of his enterprises to underlings while he concentrated on food and revelry in [[Nem'ro's Palace|his palace]] on Nal Hutta.<ref name="HoloNet Bio" /> His closest associates, for a time, included the lieutenants [[Carnus]],<ref name="TOR:BC" /> [[Karrels Javis]] and [[Toth'lazhen]], as well as the enforcer [[Kaliyo Djannis]],<ref name="TOR:Soiree" /> and [[Nem'ro's gang|his street gang]] leader, [[Rex Geer]].<ref name="TOR:GW" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], his rivalry with Fa'athra became so intense that Fa'athra sent [[Fa'athra gang|forces]] into Jiguuna to attack Nem'ro's interests.<ref name="TOR:SA" />

====Great Hunt====
{{Quote|If you succeed, I win. If you fail, I still win. Either way, the toughest man on Hutta goes to the Great Hunt with my name!|Suudaa Nem'ro, to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:MS">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|My Sponsorship|Hutta}}</ref>}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates:1">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Nem'ro sponsored the [[Hunter (individual)|protégé]] of the late [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Braden]] after the protégé assisted the Hutt with his business,<ref name="TOR:MS"/> killing several targets,<ref name="TOR:BC" /><ref name="TOR:SA" /><ref name="TOR:HC">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|House Cleaning|Hutta}}</ref> and finally killing the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] bounty hunter [[Rarsk]] in [[Fa'athra's Palace]], acquiring the sponsorship token Nem'ro had given him.<ref name="TOR:MS"/> Nem'ro's sponsored hunter would go on to win the competition.<ref name="TOR:HtCH">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Hail the Conquering Hero|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>

====Allying with the Sith Empire====
{{Quote|Jiguuna is an industrial town, and Nem'ro runs most of the industry. The Hutt plies weapons, drugs and raw materials--but not to us. We believe Nem'ro has been reluctant to lose Republic customers by publicly siding with the Empire. It's time he overcame this reluctance.|[[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|Keeper]], to [[Cipher Nine]]|<ref name="TOR:CYNI">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|Claim Your New Identity|Hutta}}</ref>}}
His operations did not go unacknowledged for long during the Cold War, as the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] took a keen interest in the Hutt and his control over the gas industry.<ref name="TOR:SKJ">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|Subverting Karrels Javis|Hutta}}</ref> The [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] spymaster known as [[Keeper (Imperial Intelligence)|"Keeper"]] sent an [[Cipher Nine|operative]] to infiltrate Nem'ro's court and gain his allegiance. Assuming the identity of the space pirate known as the "[[Red Blade]],"<ref name="TOR:Soiree" /> the agent gained the trust of Nem'ro and his closest men, carrying out several tasks on their behalf.<ref name="TOR:SKJ" /><ref name="TOR:EoS">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|Economies of Scale|Hutta}}</ref>

In the end, after framing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for having aided Fa'athra in assassinating Karrels Javis and his bodyguards inside Nem'ro's palace itself, and gaining [[Hologram disc/Legends|holodisc]] evidence of this,<ref name="TOR:CoP" /> the agent succeeded in driving Nem'ro to the Imperials. The Hutt soon contacted nearby [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] embassies, and Keeper expected to have him on the Empire's side within the month.<ref name="TOR:TNT" />

===Assassination===
{{Quote|The average Hutt lifespan is a thousand years. Nem'ro was only six hundred. ''Stupid'' bounty hunter!|[[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]]|<ref name="TOR:SNYSF" />}}
It was later revealed that Nem'ro was infected with a seemingly incurable [[Suudaa Nem'ro's disease|disease]], which was eventually cured by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]].<ref name="TOR:HaH">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Archiban Kimble|Healing a Hutt}}</ref> Despite the doctor's hard work,<ref name="TOR:SNYSF" /> Nem'ro was then killed by [[Skadge]],<ref name="TOR:Slugfest">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Skadge|Slugfest}}</ref> the Houk having [[Invasion of Belsavis|escaped]] the [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] [[Belsavis prison|prison]]<ref name="TOR:NSA">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|No Strings Attached|Belsavis}}</ref> and eventually tracking him down, ending the Hutt's life<ref name="TOR:Slugfest" /> before Doctor Kimble could report the successful cure in the ''[[Journal of Xenomedicine]]''.<ref name="TOR:SNYSF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nem'ro the Hutt was first mentioned in a development diary for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]],<ref name="VD3">{{TORweb|url=news/article/20090717_002|text=The Voice of the Old Republic|nolive=1}}</ref> and later appeared in the opening storylines for both the Bounty Hunter<ref name="TOR:BC" /> and Imperial Agent classes on Nal Hutta.<ref name="TOR:Soiree" />

Nem'ro's biography page on the official website contained several phrases in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]. When transliterated, they read "Supports Hutt Cartel Neutrality," "Houk and Rattataki Bodyguards," and "Betrayed Skadge."<ref name="HoloNet Bio" />
